title: implement_result
description: The structured answer the implementer returns. Handed to `codex exec --output-schema`, validated before any state advances, and kept in the attempt directory as evidence. `behaviour_changed` and `seam_confirmed` are what let the control plane decide, without guessing, whether the red-phase replay is required. Every key in `properties` also appears in `required`, because OpenAI structured outputs reject a response format where it does not; a field that may legitimately have no value says so with an empty array or an explicit null, never by being absent.

behaviour_changed.description: Required, not optional. P0-14 measured what happens when it is absent: the replay has no trigger, so a behaviour change with no test is indistinguishable from a docs edit and the check rounds itself to green. A missing value blocks.
